words.sense: To obstruct progress toward a goal or prevent a plan from succeeding.
misconceptions: Missing the suppression of developing ideas when existing tasks continue.
Confusing obstacles to a goal with discouragement of expression.

words.sense: To hold back an expression, feeling, or emerging activity.
misconceptions: Calling any expression of reluctance a complete block to progress.
Confusing obstacles to a goal with discouragement of expression.
